body.title: Resolve a plan test name that lists several test files
body.reproduction: Give an approved plan task the test name 'artifact-content.test.ts and pending.test.ts: the existing workflow.artifactContent and workflow.pending tests, unchanged', where both files exist under src/workflow/__tests__. Run insrc_build_step validate on that task. Observed: the test run reports 'named tests matched no test file: artifact-content.test.ts and pending.test.ts: ...', the two files are never run, and the task fails with testsPassed false even though every acceptance check is judged satisfied (this happened to E1 s5 task t3; both files pass 32/32 when run by hand). Expected: both files are run, and the task passes when they pass.
body.rootCause: resolveTaskTestFiles in src/mcp/build-step/validation-checks.ts maps a test name to files only through LEADING_TEST_FILE, which accepts exactly one '<base>.test.ts' followed by ':' at the start of the name. In 'artifact-content.test.ts and pending.test.ts: ...' the first file name is followed by ' and', not ':', so the pattern does not match, the name goes to unresolved, and planTaskCheckPlan passes it on as an unresolved test, which makes the test check fail.
body.fixIntent: When the leading part of a test name, before its ':', lists several test files joined by 'and' or commas, resolve it to every listed file, so all of them are run. This holds everywhere the leading prefix is read, including the plan builder that first filters names by it, so a multi-file name is neither left unresolved nor reported as naming no test file. A name whose leading part names no test file stays unresolved as today, and a '*.test.ts' mention after the ':' still does not count.
